summary: Learn to design, test, and deploy business AI assistants with practical tools, controls, and rollout methods. Enroll today.
lede: Building AI Agents and Assistants for Business helps teams turn AI concepts into practical copilots, workflow assistants, and agentic process support. You will learn to evaluate opportunities, prioritize use cases, define assistant scope, and design workflows using prompt design and retrieval-augmented generation patterns. The course also covers human-in-the-loop operations, knowledge-base design, test cases, validation checklists, and rollout planning. You will define success through task completion, response accuracy, escalation, and adoption measures while applying realistic controls for data access, content review, model limitations, and escalation rules.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to select, design, review, or sponsor AI agents and assistants that support real business workflows.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of business processes, process maps, and basic digital tools such as spreadsheets and shared knowledge bases. No coding is required for completion, although familiarity with AI copilots, prompt-based tools, or workflow automation platforms will help you move faster. The course is taught at an intermediate level, with advanced AI engineering topics covered only at conceptual or operational level, not production engineering depth.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
